text: Transportation Services, in collaboration with Development Review, is requesting City Council authorization to implement road alterations at Highway 2A/Military Trail as an interim measure to achieve the goals of the Highland Creek Village Transportation Master Plan (TMP). This work will comprise the following: - The closure of the south end of Morrish Road through the installation of a cul‑de‑sac - The closure of the Highway 2A/Kingston Road off‑ramp to Morrish Road - Associated roadway and geometric modifications - The delivery of pedestrian connections and landscaping on the closed portion of Morrish Road - Required traffic by-law amendments The TMP was adopted by City Council in May 2021 and provides the policy context for the proposed changes.
